Problem Statement:
✨ Allow using dependables with `functools.partial()`

Discussion: https://github.com/tiangolo/fastapi/discussions/9744

Using `functools.partial()` with dependables feels like a very obvious idiom. `partial()` already works for dependables that are plain function, but it doesn't work consistently, partial of async and callable classes didn't work consistently.

This PR makes partial() work consistently in all combinations.

turns.reply: The fix is in `fastapi/dependencies/models.py`: `Dependant._unwrapped_call` now unwraps `functools.partial` layers, so the async, generator, and async-generator checks see the underlying callable instead of `partial.__call__`. I checked async function, generator, async generator and callable-class partials directly, and `tests/test_dependency_class.py` passes (8 tests). I did not run `test_dependency_types.py` or the wider suite.
